listing.name: Custom LPCs v1.2.0 - Prometheus (LP IED) Chip Edition™
listing.summary: Create your own fighter wings in-game!
listing.aiSummary: Lets you create custom fighter wings by applying a hullmod to any ship.

description:
Custom LPCs v1.2.0

Create your own fighter wings in-game!

[How to Use]

Spoiler

Adds 1 hullmod, and 1 fighter wing.

Hullmod can be found during exploration, and wing is sold in independant/pirate/black market.

Apply hullmod to a ship, and the wing will become that ship!

LPC OP cost will dynamically change. Currently it is (DP Cost)*5. Example : https://imgur.com/a/ag8eZFO

discordPostHtml:
Create your own fighter wings in-game!

Adds 1 hullmod, and 1 fighter wing.
Apply hullmod to frigateship, and the wing will become that frigateship!
LPC will dynamically change its OP cost and description.

Download: https://github.com/ymfah/CustomLPCs/releases/
Forum Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=29658.0
aiDescription: Adds a hullmod found during exploration and a fighter wing sold in independent, pirate, and black markets. Applying the hullmod to a ship turns that ship into the wing's LPCs. The operating cost of these LPCs changes dynamically based on the ship's DP cost.

changelog.1.1.0:
- Completely reworked hullmod and wing.

 LPC will dynamically change depending on the hull used.
 OP cost is changed from 30 to (Base Hull DP)*5.
 Refit time changed from 30 to (Base Hull DP)*5.
 LPC now changes description to show what hull it will produce.
 Can now be applied to ALL hulls and not just frigates.
 Properly applies captains if fighters are supposed to have one(Aarma, Better Vanilla Hullmods™, etc)
 Removed CR, Dmod, Health penalties.

- QoL

 Made the LPC more likely to show up.
 Fixed the version file.
